other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded Submission IDs
other_failure_modes.description: The agent hardcodes the 'id' column in the submission file using a sequentially generated range instead of preserving the actual IDs from the test dataset. This causes evaluation systems to fail to join the predictions with the ground truth.

other_failure_modes.name: Validation Leak in Frequency Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Frequency encoding for categorical variables is computed on the entire training dataset prior to cross-validation. This leaks the distribution characteristics of the validation folds into the training folds.

summary: The agent builds a highly sophisticated pipeline with robust domain-specific feature engineering, proper cross-validation, and a tuned ensemble of LightGBM and a PyTorch MLP. However, a critical execution oversight occurs when generating the submission file: it overwrites the original test IDs with a generic sequential range, which breaks downstream automated evaluation. Additionally, there is a minor validation data leak during frequency encoding and a reliance on simple accuracy despite class imbalance.
